label: Ворот
description: A 10-sentence usage card for ворот (collar; gate).

missions.phrase: У этой рубашки слишком узкий ворот.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Ворот' is the masculine nominative subject, here meaning the collar of a shirt. 'Узкий' is the agreeing adjective, and 'у этой рубашки' is the genitive of possession. A basic clothing description.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Ворот' is the masculine inanimate accusative, identical to the nominative, as the object of 'расстегнул'. 'Рубашки' is the genitive of relation. A natural everyday gesture.
Strategic focus: Accusative after 'за'. 'За ворот' uses the masculine accusative after 'за' to show where the wind blew. 'Мне' is the dative of the affected person. An idiomatic, vivid expression.

Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'за'. 'За воротом' uses the masculine instrumental 'воротом' to show the resting location behind the collar. 'Снег' is the nominative subject. Contrast it with the accusative of motion.

Strategic focus: Genitive of source after 'от'. 'Ворота' is the masculine genitive after 'от' to show what the button came off. 'Пуговица' is the feminine nominative subject. A practical household sentence.

Strategic focus: Dative plural after 'к'. In the gate sense 'ворота' is plural-only, so 'к воротам' uses the dative plural to show the destination. 'Машина' is the nominative subject. The standard 'drove up to the gate' pattern.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural-only subject. In the gate sense 'ворота' is grammatically plural even for a single gate. 'Большие' agrees in the plural, and 'открыты' is the short-form predicate. A key noun to learn as plurale tantum.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural after 'возле'. The gate sense 'ворота' gives the genitive plural 'ворот' after 'возле'. 'Деревянных' agrees in the genitive plural. A natural location phrase by the gate.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural after 'в'. The gate sense 'ворота' gives the accusative plural after 'в' to show where the knocking lands. 'Кто-то' is the nominative subject. A common everyday scene.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural after 'за'. The gate sense 'ворота' gives the instrumental plural 'воротами' after 'за' to show what lies beyond. 'Лес' is the nominative subject. Good for describing a setting.
